### 1. What the user expresses, simulator mode
Nadia Hartwell opens: closing on September 17 passed; she emailed the desk Monday October 5 asking for an extension; portal shows a $1,500 extension fee and an addendum awaiting signature with the date blank; she wants the new closing date set today and will sign herself. Target object: her Home Purchase Agreement on LM-0236; timing: today; action boundary: set the new closing date / sign the extension addendum herself (user-owned action); authorisation: she signs. She gives identity items one or two at a time when asked; on financing she confirms (only if asked) the withdrawn Calloway Home Mortgage lock and Front Range Credit Union funding at the very end of October, "any closing date after that suits". She reacts to a per diem charge only if the agent explains it ("go ahead"), accepts any amount, signs the addendum with the details given and reads back the new date. Passive if/else simulator; executes the user tool only when handed it.

### 2. Act / wait / refuse at the frozen moment
Act now, in order (per diem first, then hand over the addendum). Visible eligibility grounds:
- `find_purchase_agreements`: status `closing_scheduled`, `closing_extensions_used` 0, Summit Collection; `closing_terms_schedule`: Summit "Buyer closing extensions allowed 2"; `closing_date_and_extensions`: "A closing extension is written only on an agreement whose status is closing scheduled."
- Ledger shows `closing_extension_fee` charge CHG-HP-2341, 1500.00, dated 2026-10-05 — matches `closing_extension_addendum`: "its closing extension fee is charged when the request is received" (request received 2026-10-05; Summit fee 1500.00). No second fee is booked.
- Scheduled closing date 2026-09-17 < today 2026-10-07: the scheduled closing date has passed and the request came after it, so the addendum's prerequisite sentence applies (see item 6).
- Not a builder delay: home stage `complete`, estimated completion 2026-09-10 before the 2026-09-17 closing; delay is the buyer's financing (simulator). So `charge_waivers` (waiver only for a builder delay recorded on the agreement) does not apply and the extension is buyer-requested.
- Default notice not due: buyer delay days 2026-09-18..2026-10-07 = 20, not exceeding Summit's 45 (`buyer_closing_delay` 12.3/12.4).

### 4. Scored parameters
**A. Closing delay per diem (agent tool `assess_closing_delay_per_diem_8d15ee11`).** Computation document `per_diem_amount`: period = day after scheduled closing through the day before booking date; first grace days unbilled; daily rate = collection per diem rounded once; amount = rate x billed days, half-up.
Factors found and the tier this customer is on:
- Period start (`delay_period_start`, rule (b) short notice): estimated completion 2026-09-10 on/before scheduled closing 2026-09-17; latest closing_date_notice 2026-08-10 is 38 days before 2026-09-17, fewer than Summit N=45 -> start = day after (2026-08-10 + 45 = 2026-09-24) = **2026-09-25**. Rule (a) fails (est. completion not after scheduled closing). Found via the ledger words "closing_date_notice" and the agreement's estimated completion date.
- Period end (`delay_period_end` (1)): closing_extension_fee charge dated 2026-10-05 > 2026-09-17 -> end = day before = **2026-10-04**. This also matches the addendum sentence "each day of buyer delay that came before the day the request was received". Found via ledger `charge_type closing_extension_fee` and its date.
- Grace days (`extension_grace_days`): exactly one closing extension fee charge on the ledger -> Summit 2 - 1 = **1** grace day.
- Daily rate, deposit cover (`deposit_cover_daily_rate`): deposits held 40649.50+24389.70+40649.50 = 105688.70 (none refunded/forfeited/applied/returned; equals `earnest_money_held`) = 13.0% of contract price 812990.00, >= 12% -> x **0.80**. Found via ledger deposits / agreement `earnest_money_held`.
- Daily rate, studio options (`studio_options_daily_rate`): design file `finalized`, option_total 68450.00 in [40000, 75000) -> x **1.10**. Found via the Design Studio Selections file record (another product's record; the doc names "Design Studio Selections file ... status and option total").
- Combination: both documents say "the collection's per diem is multiplied by ..." and "The multiple acts on the collection's per diem before the daily rate is rounded to the cent"; read multiplicatively: 225.00 x 0.80 x 1.10 = 198.00 (rounded once, exact). Note: no visible sentence states explicitly how two daily-rate multiples combine; the multiplicative reading is the natural one but an additive reading (225 x (1 - 0.20 + 0.10) = 202.50) is not literally excluded by a sentence — carried to gt_comparison.
- Period 2026-09-25..2026-10-04 = 10 days; billed = 10 - 1 = 9; amount = 198.00 x 9 = **1782.00**.
- Fall-back (computation document alone, collection figures from `closing_terms_schedule`): period 2026-09-18..2026-10-06 = 19 days, grace 2, billed 17, rate 225.00 -> 3825.00. Definite and different.

**B. Extension days (user tool `sign_closing_extension_addendum_c0ddd0a3`).** Computation document `closing_extension_length`: base length = collection closing extension days (Summit 14), counted from the current scheduled closing date; new date = day reached; length = days from current scheduled closing date to the new closing date.
- Base length (`extension_base_length`): financing_type `outside_lender` and the buyer's Builder Extended Rate Lock stands `withdrawn` -> **21**. Found from the agreement's financing type and the rate-lock record status (another product's record, named "Builder Extended Rate Lock ... Calloway Home Mortgage").
- Counting day (`extension_counting_day` item 1): after booking A, the ledger carries per diem whose latest period ends 2026-10-04 >= 2026-09-17 -> counts from **2026-10-04**.
- Courtesy (`construction_slip_courtesy`): estimated completion 2026-09-10 is 13 days after contract completion 2026-08-28 (<= 21) -> **+7** calendar days.
- Day reached 2026-10-04 + 21 + 7 = 2026-11-01 (Sunday) -> `weekend_closing_dates`: Sunday moves to the Monday after -> new closing date **2026-11-02**.
- extension_days = days from 2026-09-17 to 2026-11-02 = **46**. Matches the customer's "very end of October, any closing date after that suits".
- Fall-back (computation document only): 2026-09-17 + 14 = 2026-10-01, extension_days 14. Definite and different.

1. agent `find_customers(phone 3035550127)` -> `verify_customer_identity` with two stated items (e.g. phone + SSN last4) -> "Identity verified (2 item(s) matched)".

5. agent `unlock_user_discoverable_tool(sign_closing_extension_addendum_c0ddd0a3)`; tell the user {purchase_id 2ed220e7-ec2f-408c-b610-73144e5a438e, extension_days 46}.
6. user `call_user_discoverable_tool` -> returned `status signed`, previous 2026-09-17, `new_closing_date 2026-11-02`, `closing_extensions_used 1`. Terminal state: per diem charge booked for 2026-09-25..2026-10-04, closing date 2026-11-02.
Backward dependency: step 6's day-counted-from depends on step 4's period end; step 4 must precede 6.

### 6. Problem tree from visible materials alone
Problems: (P1) closing delay per diem for the buyer delay before the request — agent-booked; (P2, root) buyer closing extension addendum — the customer's own write. Direction: P2 waits on P1. Order: P1, then P2.
- Hop P2 -> P1 — **state-derived**. Sentence (closing_extension_addendum, Rule): "Where the buyer asks for the extension after the scheduled closing date has passed, the new closing date is set only after the ledger carries closing delay per diem for every day of buyer delay before the extension request was received." and its restatement "the new closing date waits until the agreement ledger shows closing delay per diem covering each day of buyer delay that came before the day the request was received." Records: scheduled closing 2026-09-17 < today; request received 2026-10-05 (simulator line + fee charge dated 2026-10-05); `find_purchase_ledger` shows no `closing_delay_per_diem` charge -> state does not hold. Searching the state's words "closing delay per diem" (KB_search ranks `buyer_closing_delay`, then the per-diem documents; grep finds the desk tool card) leads to `closing_delay_per_diem_charge` ("books one closing delay per diem charge ... recording the delay period's start date and end date") — the write that brings the state about — and to `per_diem_amount` for its amount. No document names the per-diem tool beside the addendum's sentence; the addendum card names only its own tool.
- P1 has no prerequisite sentence in its own documents; the tree ends there.
- The same order is independently entailed by `extension_counting_day` (item 1 reads the per diem period on the ledger).

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only what she asked" (hand over the addendum now): excluded by the addendum's own rule sentence above plus the empty per diem ledger — the new closing date may not be set before the ledger carries per diem; also it would count from 2026-09-17 (14 or 21 days) and land before her funding date.
- Closest alternatives: per diem from 2026-09-18 (excluded by `delay_period_start` (b), notice 38 < 45 days); through 2026-10-06 (excluded by `delay_period_end` (1), fee charge 2026-10-05); 2 grace days (excluded by `extension_grace_days`, one fee charge); rate 225 (excluded by the two rate documents and the deposit/design records); base 14 (excluded by `extension_base_length`, outside_lender + withdrawn lock); counting from 2026-09-17 or from the estimated completion date (excluded by `extension_counting_day` item 1 once per diem is on the ledger; item 2 needs no per diem and est. completion after closing, both false); 14 courtesy days (13-day slip <= 21); new date 2026-11-01 (Sunday; weekend rule); charging a second 1500 fee (fee already charged on receipt of the request, CHG-HP-2341); waiving fee/per diem as builder delay (home complete before closing; delay is the buyer's).
- Open point (not closed by a visible sentence): how the deposit-cover and studio-options multiples combine (product vs. summed adjustment). Recorded as an observation for gt_comparison.
